value: MEFs were infected with rtTA alone or with Ascl1+rtTA. Doxycycline (dox) was added one day post infection. For cells harvested after 48 hours, MEF media was replaced neuronal media (DMEM-F12 + N2 supplement + B27 supplement + insulin + dox), and media was refreshed every 2-3 days.

Homozygous TauEGFP knock-in mice (Tucker et al., 2001) were bred with C57B/6 mice (Taconic) to generate heterozygous embryos. MEFs were isolated from E13.5 embryos and cultured in MEF media (5% cosmic calf serum + sodium pyruvate + pen/strep + MEM NEAA + 0.8% 2-Mercaptoethanol in DMEM). Cortical neurons were isolated by dissecting cortical tissue from E15.5 embryos and sorting for TauEGFP+ cells.

Cells were trypsinzed in 0.05% trypsin and processed at different time points post-dox. From day 5, cells were FAC sorted by TauEGFP. ATAC-seq protocol outlined by Buenrostro, et al (Nat. Methods, 2013)
